description: This file defines a decorator class 'TimesheetDecorator' for the 'Timesheet' entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to format and access timesheet dates, set associated employee data, and retrieve the current state of the timesheet in a human-readable format.

classes.name: TimesheetDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds presentation logic to the Timesheet entity, including date formatting and state representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific Timesheet instance.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the timesheet.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the timesheet.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the timesheet using the employee's number.

methods.name: getTimesheetState
methods.description: Provides the current state of the timesheet in a human-readable format.
